title: Readable Sale Copy Every Size
tests: Preserves complete, readable ad copy and visual hierarchy when adapting one design to three substantially different canvas shapes.

faults.what: Only two finished images are supplied; the requested square 1:1 variant is missing.
Both supplied layouts repeat 'Visit 24 Willow Lane' in a separate bottom area, adding unnecessary duplicate text.
The supplied landscape and portrait canvases are close to, but not exactly, the requested 16:9 and 9:16 proportions.

judge.summary: The two supplied ads are readable and visually coordinated, but the requested three-format set is incomplete and both layouts unnecessarily repeat the address.

must_haves.item: Three finished images have the requested 1:1, 9:16 and 16:9 aspect ratios.
must_haves.why: Only landscape and portrait images are shown, with no square variant; their visible canvas proportions also differ slightly from the requested ratios.

must_haves.item: All five specified text strings appear correctly and completely in every variant.
must_haves.why: All five strings are correct and complete in both supplied images, but the required square variant is absent.

must_haves.item: Every text line, including 'Visit 24 Willow Lane', is comfortably readable when each image is viewed at its delivered size without zooming.
must_haves.why: All lines in both supplied images are large enough to read comfortably, including both address placements.

must_haves.item: Text has clear contrast against its background and is not obscured by leaves or other text.
must_haves.why: Dark green text stands clearly against cream backgrounds, with plants kept away from the lettering.

must_haves.item: No text is clipped, pushed against the canvas edge or distorted to fit.
must_haves.why: The supplied images retain adequate text margins and show no clipped or visibly compressed lettering.

must_haves.item: The variants retain matching leafy imagery and green-and-cream styling while adjusting text placement or line breaks to suit each shape.
must_haves.why: The two supplied variants share matching plants, colors and typography, with side-aligned content in landscape and centered content in portrait.
